hook_line: Most agency owners I know added MORE clients this year and somehow took home LESS money.
concept: Agency owners add more clients but take home less under flat retainers (a ‘built-in ceiling’); pitches switching to a performance-cut model where an AI bot texts a client’s old forgotten leads and books sales calls automatically.
problem_mechanism: the retainer model has a built-in ceiling — the only way to earn more is take on more clients
solution_mechanism: AI bot texts a client’s old forgotten leads, qualifies and books calls, paid 30-50% of profit per sale

hook_line: I've invented a “Make Money With AI” system based on what filthy rich Hedge Fund Managers do.
concept: Dan explains a ‘Make Money With AI’ system modeled on hedge-fund managers’ performance-fee structure — reactivate old leads/customers via a 2-line SMS/WhatsApp message on a percentage-of-profit basis, no upfront cost to the client.
problem_mechanism: old/dead lead databases businesses paid for but never followed up on
solution_mechanism: performance-fee model copied from hedge funds: 2-line SMS/WhatsApp to old leads, AI handles the rest, paid up to 50% of profit

hook_line: My client pays me $10k per month, every single month, just to get hold of leads their sales team can’t.
concept: A sales team hammers fresh leads for 48 hours then dumps non-responders in a ‘dead leads’ bin; Dan’s AI bot picks those up, texts them, and books appointments for a flat $10k/mo — earning without touching the client’s fresh pipeline or sales team.

solution_mechanism: AI bot picks up the discarded leads, sends SMS, qualifies and books appointments automatically

solution_mechanism: AI+SMS old-lead reactivation, client pays 30-50% of resulting sales

hook_line: I ran a weird campaign for a client that paid me $222,600 with ZERO ad spend.
concept: Case study aimed at existing lead-gen/marketing agency owners: a $222,600 payout with zero ad spend from working an existing client’s dormant CRM leads with an AI employee — framed as an add-on, not a replacement, to their current service.
problem_mechanism: agencies chase new clients and ignore forgotten/old lead databases already sitting in a client's CRM
solution_mechanism: an ‘AI employee’ dropped into the existing client's database, texting old leads and booking appointments for 30-50% of resulting sales

hook_line: The LESS AI you know, the more you get paid!

problem_mechanism: the ‘Learner Brain’ — the instinct to fully master the tech before starting, which keeps people stuck in analysis paralysis
